response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'Clears the 11-scan mark' means scancount > 11 (strictly greater than 11).

The inner JOIN drops scans with no matching site, as the request asks. AVG skips NULL pressratio and scancount values, which satisfies 'ignore missing values'. A NULL phasefactor is kept as its own group, and NULLS LAST places groups with no average compression ratio at the end.
The query runs on PostgreSQL, which the schema's CONSTRAINT syntax suggests, so NULLS LAST is supported. Averages are not rounded, because AVG on NUMERIC returns the full value.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Clears the 11-scan mark' includes scans with exactly 11 scans (scancount >= 11).
